why_early_formal_smoothness_does_not_pro.G_global: Imposing full G-equivariance collapses polynomial candidates to the 4-dimensional space already excluded by septic_landing_check / modular_covariant_scan. Early formal smoothness never reaches that space with F(p)=0.
why_early_formal_smoothness_does_not_pro.based_coupling: Based ledger forces a7=p|_{E_-}=0, removing the only remaining degree-7 E- correction that could cancel some high-order residuals.
why_early_formal_smoothness_does_not_pro.formal_smoothness: On the free-module open U where every L_r (r odd) is surjective, the polar tower admits formal power-series solutions in the normal variable y (accepted higher_polar_recursion / rank theorem).
why_early_formal_smoothness_does_not_pro.no_candidate: Tower exit is G7-OBSTRUCTION, consistent with the accepted exclusion. No G7-CANDIDATE appears; no inconsistency to locate.
why_early_formal_smoothness_does_not_pro.polynomial_truncation: A homogeneous map of degree 7 has normal order ≤7. The last E+ isolable correction within degree is b6 at F-order 8. From F-order 10 onward the free-module isolator would require b8,b10,… which do not exist as polynomial jets of degree 7.
why_early_formal_smoothness_does_not_pro.terminal_system: Finite truncation (G1) converts the infinite formal problem into the finite residual equations at even F-orders 10…20 (and 0,2 empty). Samples on the residual-trivial free fibre produce nonzero terminal residual — exact over Q.
